rangePolicy.selection: Prefer the suggested ranges; readability and explicit user choices take priority. Record a reason when choosing outside a suggested range.
rangePolicy.units: Numbers refer to Jianying panel controls, not preview pixels. Calibrate panel-to-draft and panel-to-preview conversions using real drafts before applying unresolved controls.

selection.consistency: Choose a main style for the film; adjust individual captions only when the footage requires it.
selection.output: Save concrete resolved appearance values in each project text item, not ranges or live library references.

adTextRoles.title: Upper headline; prefer orange or red with a dark outline, with yellow or cyan when the frame needs it.
adTextRoles.coreSellingPoint: White label with dark blue or black lettering; keep the label behind the text and clear of the subject.
adTextRoles.emphasis: Yellow, orange or red emphasis line with a dark outline.
adTextRoles.evidence: White or light supporting line with a dark outline only on a dark background; otherwise use cyan, yellow or black.
adTextRoles.location: Separate lower-right safe-area location, usually split into two short lines; use the supplied text only.

font.source: All six candidates have packaged font files registered in text-fonts.json; no system installation, Jianying cache or online font library is required at runtime.
font.selection: Choose an available candidate appropriate to the footage and copy; keep the primary font consistent.
font.availability: Resolve each candidate through its fontId in the packaged registry. Use embedded font CSS for rendering and portable font references for native draft export; do not invent Jianying resource IDs.
font.missingCandidates: Report missing fonts; ask for a font file or an approved alternative if no candidate is available.

fill.selection: Inspect the footage behind the intended text placement across its visible interval. Choose the most readable color from the palette, then inspect the composed result. Do not choose white as a fill unless the person explicitly requests white.

background.selection: When enabled, choose one of these two alternatives according to footage and readability; do not combine them. Percentages follow Jianying panel controls; do not assume a CSS radius reference.

implementation.executor: AI agent reading this policy; no automatic pixel-analysis engine is implied.
implementation.onUnresolvedSetting: Do not pass policy values directly as preview pixels, invent draft fields, silently omit settings or claim native support. Report the unresolved setting; if rendering is needed, disclose it and retain editable text where possible.
